name: US Census Bureau Variables
description: US Census Bureau demographic variables. The variables are directly extracted from the census api. Each of the subdatasets contains a different set of variables, such as 65+ demographics, Asian not Hispanic demographics, and core demographics. The temporal coverage varies by subdataset and the variables codes are specified in their corresponding configuration file found at https://github.com/NSAPH-Data-Processing/us_census_time_series_extractor/tree/main/conf/variables

top_display.name: Temporal Coverage
top_display.value: Look at subdatasets for temporal coverage

name: US Census Bureau Variables - 65 Plus Demographics
description:
US Census Bureau demographic variables focused on populations aged 65 and over. Variables include population over 65 years, high school attainment, and poverty levels for seniors. The temporal coverage for counties is: acs5 (2007-2020). The temporal coverage for zctas is: acs5 (2009-2020). 
 The variables are directly extracted from the census api using codes specified in the 65_plus.yaml configuration file at https://github.com/NSAPH-Data-Processing/us_census_time_series_extractor/tree/main/conf/variables.

content.fips: String: 5-digit FIPS code for county-level data (county_yearly only)
content.zcta: String: 5-digit ZIP Code Tabulation Area (ZCTA) for zipcode-level data (zcta_yearly only)
content.year: Int: Year of the census record. For acs5, the year is the middle year of the 5 year period.
content.pop_over_65_years: Float: Population over 65 years (male and female combined)
content.pop_65_plus_high_school_not_attained: Float: Population 65+ who did not complete high school
content.pop_65_plus_below_poverty_level: Float: Population 65+ with income below poverty level

name: US Census Bureau Variables - Asian Not Hispanic Demographics
description:
US Census Bureau demographic variables focused on Asian (not Hispanic) populations and language characteristics. Variables include foreign-born percentages, language spoken at home, English proficiency, and racial/ethnic composition. The temporal coverage for counties is: acs5 (2007-2020), dec (2000). The temporal coverage for zctas is: acs5 (2009-2020), dec (2000). 
 The variables are directly extracted from the census api using codes specified in the asian_not_hispanic.yaml configuration file at https://github.com/NSAPH-Data-Processing/us_census_time_series_extractor/tree/main/conf/variables.

content.fips: String: 5-digit FIPS code for county-level data (county_yearly only)
content.zcta: String: 5-digit ZIP Code Tabulation Area (ZCTA) for zipcode-level data (zcta_yearly only)
content.year: Int: Year of the census record. For acs5, the year is the middle year of the 5 year period. For dec, the year represents the decennial census year.
content.pct_foreign_born: Float: Percentage of population that is foreign born
content.pct_speak_english_less_than_very_well: Float: Percentage who speak English less than very well
content.pct_speak_spanish_at_home: Float: Percentage who speak Spanish at home
content.pct_speak_spanish_at_home_english_less_t: Float: Percentage who speak Spanish at home and English less than very well
content.pct_speak_asian_pacific_at_home: Float: Percentage who speak Asian and Pacific Islander languages at home
content.pct_speak_asian_pacific_at_home_english_: Float: Percentage who speak Asian/Pacific languages at home and English less than very well
content.pct_hispanic: Float: Percentage of population that is Hispanic or Latino
content.pct_asian_not_hispanic: Float: Percentage of population that is Asian alone, not Hispanic

name: US Census Bureau Variables - Core Demographics
description:
US Census Bureau core demographic variables including population counts, age distributions, race/ethnicity, education, poverty, and housing characteristics. This represents the most commonly used census variables. The temporal coverage for counties is: acs1 (2005-2022), acs5 (2007-2020), dec (2000, 2010, 2020). The temporal coverage for zctas is: acs5 (2009-2020), dec (2000, 2010, 2020). 
 The variables are directly extracted from the census api using codes specified in the core.yaml configuration file at https://github.com/NSAPH-Data-Processing/us_census_time_series_extractor/tree/main/conf/variables.

content.fips: String: 5-digit FIPS code for county-level data (county_yearly only)
content.zcta: String: 5-digit ZIP Code Tabulation Area (ZCTA) for zipcode-level data (zcta_yearly only)
content.year: Int: Year of the census record. For acs1/acs5, the year is the middle year of the survey period. For dec, the year represents the decennial census year.
content.median_age: Float: Median age of the population
content.pop_black: Float: Black or African American population
content.pop_native: Float: American Indian and Alaska Native population
content.pop_higher_education_enrolled: Float: Population enrolled in higher education
content.pop_higher_education_attained: Float: Population with higher education degree
